🧸PRODUCT DESCRIPTION

Baby Tummy Time Water Mat

Make tummy time fun and engaging with this Premium Baby Inflatable Water Play Mat, specially designed to support your baby’s early development. Filled with colorful floating toys, it keeps babies entertained while helping strengthen their neck, shoulder, and arm muscles.

This soft and leak-proof mat creates a safe, stimulating environment where babies can enjoy playtime while improving motor skills and coordination.

👶 Key Features:

✅ Perfect Size – 18x24 inches; ideal for infants & toddlers, portable for home/travel
✅ Engaging Water Play – Watch colorful foam fishes float, stimulating curiosity
✅ Encourages Tummy Time – Strengthens neck, shoulder & arm muscles
✅ Supports Early Development – Stimulates visual tracking, hand-eye coordination & fine motor skills
✅ Safe & Baby-Friendly – Made from BPA-free, non-toxic, leak-proof PVC
✅ Soft & Comfortable – Cushioned surface for a cozy tummy time experience
✅ Easy Setup & Storage – Inflate border, fill with water, deflate for easy transport
✅ Indoor & Outdoor Use – Lightweight & portable for play anywhere
